source: lab (real recording; background blurred by 'Segment Anything 2 Demo' editing, watermark bottom-right)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 = t 0
units: pixels (image x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale estimated

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of floor/wall region vs frame 0 <= 0.46 px in x, <= 0.1 px in y over all frames; scene/camera_shift.csv)

intrinsics_from_benchmark_convention.note: Orbbec Femto Mega RGB, f = 0.5959 * width

camera.view: elevated, looking down-forward at an indoor floor; floor occupies most of the image, receding upward (farther = higher in image, smaller)

perspective_cues.wall_floor_junction_line: dark baseboard line from about (5,375) to (630,195) (left wall, runs away from camera toward upper-right)
floor_tape_marks: white strip lower-left from about (315,620) to (405,715)
faint white strip mid-floor from about (610,425) to (680,475)
perspective_cues.apparent_size_vs_image_y: basketball diameter 84 px at y=615 (frame 0) -> 72 px at y=465 (frame 48); soccer ball ~45 px at y=303 (frame 0) and ~42-47 px hull width at y=330-410

dropped_frames_suspected.evidence: both balls jump ~1.6-1.8x their neighbouring per-frame steps (basketball 45.6 px vs ~20-29; soccer 37 px vs ~17-23)
both balls step ~2x neighbours (basketball 10.3 px vs ~5; soccer 7.5 vs ~4.7)

events.event: person_A starts kicking soccer ball (start of soccer ball motion)
person_B foot contacts basketball (start of basketball motion)
balls collide (contact; centres 63-65 px apart vs radii sum ~58-60 px; soccer ball reverses direction, basketball drops from ~17 to ~2-6 px/frame)

basketball continues slowly to upper-left after collision (~5 px/frame, nearly constant)
soccer ball reaches person_A's right shoe (contact/stop)
